name: cell_diagram
description: An animal-cell cross-section: membrane (double line) around cytoplasm, with a selectable set of organelles — nucleus (with nucleolus), mitochondrion (with cristae), endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, ribosomes — each labeled with collision-solved leader labels. Choose this scene for requests about cell structure, organelles, 'draw a cell', or explaining what a specific organelle does (include just the relevant organelles and glow/point at them while narrating).

organelles.description: Which organelles to draw. Default: all. For a focused explanation, include only what the narration needs.

labels.description: Show organelle name labels (default true). Set false if the narration will name things instead.

element_ids.mito / cristae: the mitochondrion outline and its inner folds

examples.request: Draw an animal cell with its organelles.
